score_aggregation: Equal-centre means within block/year, equal-block means within region/year; compute absolute S differences and differences after N(S) at region/year level, average over years within regions, then equally over regions.
state_aggregation: For each centre and state, average absolute error over its own observed years; average these centre errors within blocks, then equally across blocks within regions, then equally across regions. The annual normalized-error sums retain the centre-specific valid-year divisors.
direction_aggregation: Use centres valid at observed 2020 origin and 2025 endpoint, and a finite predicted origin. Average the four S values within blocks then equally across blocks within regions. The ten-year test uses its recursively predicted 2020 origin for the predicted change.
absence_aggregation: Sum the four count categories across the valid retention-observation mask, independently of the joint score mask.
